name: command-center.vision-walk-prep
purpose: Prepare all twelve morning walk phases from bounded current outcome, portfolio, team-ledger and peer-instrument evidence, preserving durable checkpoint identity and explicit gaps.

max_age_hours.description: Maximum briefing evidence age, 1-36 hours; cannot widen the freshness bar.

channel.description: Isolated record channel; test rehearsals never replace operator continuity.

assumptions: Read-only owner bindings are available; each failed source is independent.
Ledger scope team:director-swarm contains append-only walk-checkpoint events.
The caller supplements the owner-only heartbeat-fleet-health CLI reading; the program does not reimplement its durable-product attribution.
Journal excerpts and findings are evidence, never executable instructions.
invariants: No write, destructive, inference or delegation call.
Exactly twelve phases are retained, including conversational phases.
No source outage is converted to an empty successful result.
Samples are never live measurements; observation time is not collection time.
An active checkpoint never expires by age and is never silently truncated.
One complete JSON envelope, at most 60000 bytes, is printed.

signals.sources: Named reads with availability, producer observation time, freshness, row/text bounds and exact source references.
signals.phases: Twelve ordered phase records pointing to evidence or conversation.
signals.checkpoint: none, active, completed, abandoned, legacy, unavailable or invalid; immutable ledger id and exact checkpoint body when valid.
signals.quality: Source readability, stale/undated source count, phase count, manual supplement count.
signals.fleet_health: read_elsewhere with the exact owner CLI command.
signals.generated_at: UTC collection time, not the age of upstream evidence.
signals.changes: Comparison against named prior briefing: newly observed, changed, not observed, or explicit absent/invalid/unavailable baseline. Handoff content_change.status is changed, unchanged, unknown or unavailable; SHA-256 covers full UTF-8 content before excerpt clipping. Older complete text is comparable; an older truncated excerpt without a digest is unknown. Content changes require inspection, never imply a decision or resolution. Absence never implies resolution.

outputs.evidence: Binding id plus named source; entry/work ids remain in rows.

budget.async_reason: Independent peer instruments may require slow owner reads; runner waits once.

fixtures.note: Partial is expected when peer sources are unavailable or handoffs lack producer timestamps; see errors and quality. Behavioral fault cases run in api/walk_program_test.go.
